parameters.query:
SELECT a.attempt_id,p.incident_id,a.proposal_id,a.target_version,a.request_id,
       (a.result='succeeded' AND p.status='EXECUTED' AND i.state='VERIFYING') AS eligible
FROM ir_remediation_attempts a
JOIN ir_proposals p ON p.proposal_id=a.proposal_id
JOIN ir_incidents i ON i.incident_id=p.incident_id
WHERE a.attempt_id=$1::bigint;

parameters.jsCode: return {json:{status:'verification_rejected', reason:'attempt is not an executed rollback in VERIFYING state'}};

const response=$json || {}; const body=response.body && typeof response.body==='object' ? response.body : {}; const prepared=$('Prepare Verification Checks').first().json; const expected=prepared.attempt.target_version; const actual=prepared.version.body?.version || 'unknown'; const health=prepared.health.body || {}; const orderMatches=Number(response.statusCode)===200 && Number(body.order_id)===prepared.order_id && body.status==='created' && body.customer_slug==='acme-bikes'; const checks=[{check_name:'version',expected,observed:actual,passed:Number(prepared.version.statusCode)===200 && actual===expected,details:{http_status:Number(prepared.version.statusCode||0)}},{check_name:'health',expected:'healthy',observed:health.status || 'unknown',passed:Number(prepared.health.statusCode)===200 && health.status==='healthy' && health.version===expected,details:{http_status:Number(prepared.health.statusCode||0),version:health.version||null}},{check_name:'synthetic_checkout',expected:'HTTP 201 + order created',observed:Number(prepared.checkout_status)===201 ? 'order_created' : `HTTP ${prepared.checkout_status}`,passed:Number(prepared.checkout_status)===201 && Number.isInteger(prepared.order_id),details:{http_status:prepared.checkout_status,order_id:prepared.order_id}},{check_name:'order_readback',expected:'HTTP 200 + matching created order',observed:orderMatches?'matching_order':`HTTP ${Number(response.statusCode||0)}`,passed:orderMatches,details:{http_status:Number(response.statusCode||0),order_id:body.order_id||null,status:body.status||null}}]; const recovered=checks.every(c=>c.passed); return {json:{attempt_id:prepared.attempt.attempt_id,incident_id:prepared.attempt.incident_id,request_id:prepared.attempt.request_id,target_version:expected,recovered,checks}};

const p=$('Prepare Verification Checks').first().json; const expected=p.attempt.target_version; const actual=p.version.body?.version || 'unknown'; const health=p.health.body || {}; const checks=[{check_name:'version',expected,observed:actual,passed:Number(p.version.statusCode)===200 && actual===expected,details:{http_status:Number(p.version.statusCode||0)}},{check_name:'health',expected:'healthy',observed:health.status||'unknown',passed:Number(p.health.statusCode)===200 && health.status==='healthy' && health.version===expected,details:{http_status:Number(p.health.statusCode||0),version:health.version||null}},{check_name:'synthetic_checkout',expected:'HTTP 201 + order created',observed:Number(p.checkout_status)===201?'order_created':`HTTP ${p.checkout_status}`,passed:Number(p.checkout_status)===201 && Number.isInteger(p.order_id),details:{http_status:p.checkout_status,order_id:p.order_id}} ,{check_name:'order_readback',expected:'matching order exists',observed:'not_run_checkout_failed',passed:false,details:{http_status:0,reason:'synthetic checkout did not create an order'}}]; return {json:{attempt_id:p.attempt.attempt_id,incident_id:p.attempt.incident_id,request_id:p.attempt.request_id,target_version:expected,recovered:false,checks}};

const successPath=$('Read Back Created Order').isExecuted; const candidate=successPath?$('Evaluate All Recovery Conditions').first().json:$('Record Missing Order Readback').first().json; const response=$json||{}; const body=response.body&&typeof response.body==='object'?response.body:{}; const actual=body.version||'unknown'; const checks=candidate.checks.map(c=>c.check_name==='version'?{...c,observed:actual,passed:Number(response.statusCode)===200&&actual===candidate.target_version,details:{...c.details,http_status:Number(response.statusCode||0),read_after_business_checks:true}}:c); return {json:{attempt_id:candidate.attempt_id,incident_id:candidate.incident_id,request_id:candidate.request_id,target_version:candidate.target_version,final_version_status:Number(response.statusCode||0),final_version:actual,checks}};

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::bigint AS attempt_id,$2::text AS incident_id,$3::text AS request_id,$4::text AS target_version,$5::jsonb AS checks),
current_release AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT ss.version FROM service_state ss JOIN services s ON s.id=ss.service_id WHERE s.service_key='checkout-api' FOR UPDATE OF ss),
locked_state AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.incident_id,i.state,a.attempt_id,a.request_id,a.result,p.proposal_id,p.status AS proposal_status,p.action_type,p.target_version FROM ir_incidents i JOIN ir_proposals p ON p.incident_id=i.incident_id JOIN ir_remediation_attempts a ON a.proposal_id=p.proposal_id WHERE i.incident_id=$2 AND i.state='VERIFYING' AND a.attempt_id=$1 AND a.request_id=$3 AND a.result='succeeded' AND p.status='EXECUTED' AND p.action_type='rollback' AND p.target_version=$4 FOR UPDATE OF i,p,a),
eligible AS (SELECT input.*,current_release.version AS database_version FROM input CROSS JOIN current_release JOIN locked_state l ON l.incident_id=input.incident_id AND l.attempt_id=input.attempt_id),
inserted AS (INSERT INTO ir_verification_checks(attempt_id,check_name,expected,observed,passed,details) SELECT e.attempt_id,c.check_name,c.expected,CASE WHEN c.check_name='version' THEN e.database_version ELSE c.observed END,CASE WHEN c.check_name='version' THEN c.passed AND e.database_version=e.target_version ELSE c.passed END,c.details||jsonb_build_object('database_version',e.database_version) FROM eligible e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(e.checks) AS c(check_name text,expected text,observed text,passed boolean,details jsonb) ON CONFLICT(attempt_id,check_name) DO UPDATE SET expected=EXCLUDED.expected,observed=EXCLUDED.observed,passed=EXCLUDED.passed,details=EXCLUDED.details,checked_at=NOW() RETURNING check_name,passed),
check_summary AS (SELECT count(*)::integer AS check_count,COALESCE(bool_and(passed),false) AS all_passed,COALESCE(array_agg(check_name ORDER BY check_name),ARRAY[]::text[]) AS check_names FROM inserted),
moved AS (UPDATE ir_incidents i SET state=CASE WHEN c.check_count=4 AND c.check_names=ARRAY['health','order_readback','synthetic_checkout','version']::text[] AND c.all_passed THEN 'RECOVERED' ELSE 'NEEDS_ATTENTION' END,recovered_at=CASE WHEN c.check_count=4 AND c.check_names=ARRAY['health','order_readback','synthetic_checkout','version']::text[] AND c.all_passed THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,updated_at=NOW(),summary=CASE WHEN c.check_count=4 AND c.check_names=ARRAY['health','order_readback','synthetic_checkout','version']::text[] AND c.all_passed THEN 'Rollback verified by final version, health, checkout, and order read-back.' ELSE 'Rollback completed but one or more recovery checks failed.' END FROM eligible e CROSS JOIN check_summary c WHERE i.incident_id=e.incident_id AND i.state='VERIFYING' RETURNING i.incident_id,i.state)
SELECT input.attempt_id,input.incident_id,input.request_id,COALESCE((SELECT state FROM moved),'STATE_GUARD_REJECTED') AS state,COALESCE((SELECT state FROM moved)='RECOVERED',false) AS recovered,(SELECT check_count FROM check_summary) AS checks_persisted,COALESCE((SELECT all_passed FROM check_summary),false) AS all_checks_passed FROM input;
